A discrete Google Titan-C security chip, automatic background updates and a physical camera shutter keep data and privacy protected without any setup on your part, and ChromeOS boots in seconds and stays fast over years of use. Add a 720p webcam with dual microphones and stereo speakers, and the Chromebook 311 handles video lessons and conference calls as capably as it handles homework.
